prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 1440×1000 desktop WEBSITE SCREENSHOT for Interview Book. Use the attached user-supplied screenshot only as style reference for warm white page, editorial Chinese question title, navy ink, thin neutral rules, red active marker, blue topic links, and visible “中文 / EN”. Do not copy the source's unsourced topic counts or IDs.

Composition B — explain the relationship between a prompt and its intent with a calm comparison layout. Header and large bilingual search as in a real documentation tool. Narrow topic sidebar with names only, no counts. Main area uses a broad question header and then a two-column relationship view: left column “题目问什么” with exact prompt “资源只够做两项时，你会如何制定下一季度规划？”; right column “为什么问 / 观察什么” with concise note “了解你如何说明目标、取舍依据与暂缓项” and three labeled facets “目标”, “取舍”, “暂缓项”. A slim labeled connector between columns reads “回答这道题时，可观察的判断过程” (do not supply an answer). Below, a topic row of links “资源分配 / 优先级 / 规划与执行”. Then a real comparison table titled “相近题目的观察差异” with three rows: limited resources (prioritization basis), conflicting priorities (conflict handling), reduced resources with unchanged goals (plan adjustment). End with source and extension reading as a quiet separate section. Clearly distinguish an evaluation purpose from a topic taxonomy. The layout should read instantly as a practical question reference, not dashboard or infographic. High legibility, modest corner radii, accessible contrast, no invented counts, answers, scoring, slogans, fake sources, decorations, or browser frame.
